edge_identity.mechanism: Retain Simple Earn Flexible rewards on BTC, ETH, or SOL source assets while an independently required Binance Convert Limit Order waits for execution.
edge_identity.direction_independence: The overlay compares the same independently selected Convert source asset, target asset, amount, limit price, and validity with and without the optional Earn enrollment. It cannot justify choosing a conversion, price, amount, or waiting horizon.
edge_identity.scope: BTC, ETH, or SOL source assets only when the exact asset is currently eligible for a Simple Earn Flexible Product and the conversion is independently required.

current_primary_terms.enrolled_asset_location: Simple Earn Flexible Product rather than frozen Spot balance
current_primary_terms.failed_simple_earn_subscription_effect: Convert Limit Order is not created
current_primary_terms.successful_subscription_effect: Funds remain in Simple Earn Flexible until order execution or a separate redemption after cancellation or expiry
current_primary_terms.failed_redemption_effect: Convert Limit Order is not executed
current_primary_terms.redeemed_or_unavailable_asset_effect: System automatically cancels the Convert Limit Order
current_primary_terms.cancellation_effect: Cancellation does not redeem the asset; it remains in Simple Earn Flexible until separately redeemed
fill_dependencies: immediate asset availability or successful Simple Earn redemption

rejection_first_economics.strict_gate: The exact lower-bound reward for the independently fixed waiting horizon must be strictly greater than every incremental cost and the precommitted missed-fill stress without changing the order or retaining the asset longer for rewards.
rejection_first_economics.why_zero: The current feature terms publish no exact eligible BTC, ETH, or SOL Simple Earn rate, tier, cap, minimum, accrual start, distribution schedule, account quota, or guaranteed redemption. The order can miss execution when redemption is delayed or fails.

sensitivity_only_reward_bps.provenance: retained BTC Simple Earn displayed base component; not an account rate or a guaranteed Convert-enrolled rate
retained BTC Simple Earn displayed maximum; explicitly not credited to full principal
generic sensitivity only; not a current Convert-enrolled account rate
generic sensitivity only; not a current Convert-enrolled account rate

rejection_first_economics.interpretation: At the retained BTC 0.27% maximum, seven full days produce only 0.517808 bps before every cost; a one-bp missed-fill shortfall would require 13.5185 days to recover. The displayed 0.02% base would require 182.5 days. Therefore exact redemption and fill risk dominates low-rate short-horizon cases.

all_required_before_read_only_prequalifi: An exact BTC, ETH, or SOL Convert Limit Order is independently required with pair, side, source amount, limit price, and maximum wait fixed without reference to rewards.
Both designated ephemeral Binance credentials are present and explicit signed read-only authority is granted.
The exact source asset, account region, Simple Earn Flexible product, personal quota, minimum, tier, current rate, accrual start, distribution timing, and redemption state are read without mutation.
A missed-fill stress is frozen from the order's independent economic purpose before any order-capable action.
candidate_gate.strict_pretrade_rejection: Reject Earn enrollment unless its exact conservative reward through the independently fixed horizon exceeds subscription, redemption, delay, missed-fill, tax, custody, alternative-yield, and operating costs while the underlying conversion remains independently positive.
separate_explicit_authority_required_for: any transfer, deposit, withdrawal, or trade
post_action_evidence_if_separately_autho: owned Convert order identity and exact lifecycle timestamps
owned Simple Earn subscription principal and rate tiers
redemption request and availability at trigger time
owned fill or missed-fill outcome and exact counterfactual
all fees, rounding, delay, tax, custody, and operating costs

retained_btc_simple_earn_rate_sensitivit.use: 0.02% displayed base component and 0.27% displayed maximum for rejection-only sensitivities; neither is credited as a guaranteed account rate

verdict.reason: The product contract genuinely preserves access to Simple Earn Flexible rewards while an independently required Convert Limit Order waits, but it can also prevent execution when redemption is unavailable. Public evidence supplies neither the exact positive rate nor a bounded missed-fill cost.

retry_trigger: Both designated ephemeral Binance credentials plus explicit signed read-only authority and an independently required exact BTC ETH or SOL Convert Limit Order with pair source amount limit price maximum waiting horizon and missed-fill stress frozen before access; or a material official eligible-asset rate quota accrual redemption fill or regional term change. Every order subscription redemption cancellation transfer or trade requires separate explicit authority.
